title: rubus ursinus
intro: Rubus ursinus, commonly known as the black raspberry or thimbleberry, is a type of bramble that belongs to the rose family. This plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which contribute to its numerous health benefits. The health benefits of Rubus ursinus include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ellagic acid, anthocyanins, and phenolic acids, which have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, anti-cancer, and antioxidant properties.
